workflow_metadata.name: GAN-Inspired Execution Audit Test Workflow
workflow_metadata.description: Automated execution audit testing using GAN-inspired approach (Agent A observes Agent B) with automatic fix triggering. v2.0.0: Adds hierarchical workflow testing for phase transitions, iteration budgets, resync protocol, and dual development modes
workflow_metadata.purpose: Continuously test Reflow workflows for friction points, tool/workflow misalignments, and usability issues by having Agent B execute workflows while Agent A observes and documents issues. v2.0.0: Now includes hierarchical workflow structure testing
workflow_metadata.key_innovation: Separates execution (Agent B - Generator) from evaluation (Agent A - Discriminator) to identify real-world friction points, then auto-triggers fixes via 98-reflow_feature_update if critical issues found
workflow_metadata.when_to_use: Periodically (weekly/monthly) or before major releases to benchmark Reflow quality and identify regressions

required_conditions: Reflow repository exists and is accessible
Hierarchical workflow files exist: workflow_master.json, phase_transitions.json, resync_protocol.json
Sufficient disk space for test system outputs
prerequisites.special_note: This workflow operates on Reflow itself (system_root = reflow_root) and spawns sub-agents for testing. v2.0.0: Now tests hierarchical workflow structure.

standard.description: Run all enabled test cases with full observation including hierarchical tests

single_test.description: Run a single test case by ID

hierarchical_only.description: Run only hierarchical workflow structure tests (phase transitions, iteration budgets, resync protocol, dual modes)

workflow_steps.name: Setup & Test Case Discovery
workflow_steps.description: Load test case registry, prepare environment, set baseline metrics

actions.purpose: Load list of test cases to execute

actions.description: Filter test cases based on entry point

actions.purpose: Store all test results, reports, and comparisons for this run
Compare current run against previous runs to detect regressions

outputs: List of test cases to execute

workflow_steps.name: Hierarchical Workflow Structure Testing (NEW v2.0.0)
workflow_steps.description: Test the hierarchical workflow structure: phase transitions, iteration budgets, resync protocol, and dual development modes

actions.description: Validate hierarchical workflow files exist and are well-formed

tests.name: Phase DAG is acyclic
tests.description: Verify that phase transitions form a valid DAG with no unintended cycles
tests.expected: Only P3↔P4 has intentional bidirectional edges (iteration loop)

tests.name: All phases reachable from P0
tests.description: Verify every phase can be reached starting from P0
tests.expected: Path exists from P0 to every phase

tests.name: P5 is terminal
tests.description: Verify P5 (Operations) is a valid terminal phase
tests.expected: P5 has no outgoing transitions except to PM (maintenance)

tests.name: Resync protocol triggered on budget exceeded
tests.description: Verify phase_transitions.json P4→P3 checks iteration budget

tests.name: Resync protocol has all required steps
Resync has mode-specific behavior
tests.description: Verify resync handles flexible vs rigid modes differently
tests.expected: Different resolution actions for flexible (update architecture) vs rigid (revert or change request)

tests.name: Both modes defined in workflow_master
tests.description: Verify workflow_master.json defines both flexible and rigid modes
tests.expected: development_modes contains 'flexible' and 'rigid' with distinct settings

tests.name: Mode-specific transition behavior
tests.description: Verify phase_transitions.json has mode_specific_behavior for P3↔P4
tests.expected: Transitions have different actions for flexible vs rigid mode

tests.name: P2→P3 creates anchor
tests.description: Verify P2→P3 transition creates architecture anchor

tests.name: P3/P4 phases remind LLM of anchor
tests.description: Verify P3 and P4 phase definitions include anchor reminder in llm_instructions

includes: Summary of all hierarchical tests (HT-001 through HT-014)

outputs: Pass/fail status for all hierarchical tests

workflow_steps.name: Agent B Execution (Generator)
workflow_steps.description: Spawn Agent B to execute Reflow workflows on each test case, following workflows strictly

actions.description: FOR EACH test case in filtered list
Spawn Agent B (Executor) via Task tool
actions.agent_instructions: You are Agent B (Executor) in a GAN-inspired execution audit. Execute Reflow workflows STRICTLY following workflow instructions. Report ALL deviations, confusion, friction points, and tool failures. DO NOT take shortcuts. Document EVERYTHING.
actions.task: Build system at {test_case.directory} following workflow path: {test_case.expected_workflow_path}
actions.isolation: Agent B does NOT have access to expected_outputs (blind execution)
actions.output_capture: Save Agent B's full transcript to tests/execution_audit/sessions/{timestamp}/{test_case.name}_agent_b_transcript.md

actions.reads: Agent B should generate EXECUTION_AUDIT_REPORT.md in test case directory
actions.validates: Report contains: deviations, friction points, time metrics, recommendations

actions.description: Copy Agent B's report to session directory

outputs: Agent B execution transcripts for each test case
workflow_steps.typical_time: 30-120 minutes per test case (depends on complexity)

llm_agent_guidance.spawning_agent_b: Use Task tool to spawn separate agent instance. Provide STRICT instructions to follow workflows exactly and report all issues. Agent B should be 'blind' to expected outputs.
llm_agent_guidance.capturing_output: Save Agent B's full conversation to transcript file for later analysis by Agent A
llm_agent_guidance.handling_failures: If Agent B cannot complete workflow, capture the failure point and reason. This is valuable data.

workflow_steps.name: Agent A Observation & Meta-Analysis (Discriminator)
workflow_steps.description: Agent A (you, the current agent) analyzes Agent B's execution, identifies patterns, root causes, and systemic issues

actions.purpose: Understand HOW Agent B encountered issues, not just WHAT issues

categories.tool_workflow_misalignment: Tool output doesn't match workflow documentation
categories.missing_documentation: Required parameters or steps not documented
categories.automation_incompatibility: Tool requires human interaction, fails in automation
categories.ambiguous_instructions: Workflow steps unclear or multiple interpretations
categories.template_issues: Template missing, broken, or doesn't match usage
categories.path_resolution_issues: Path conflicts or incorrect path assumptions
categories.hierarchical_phase_transition_issues: Phase transition rules violated or missing prerequisites
categories.hierarchical_iteration_budget_issues: Iteration budget not enforced or counter not updated
categories.hierarchical_resync_protocol_issues: Resync protocol incomplete or not triggered correctly
categories.hierarchical_architecture_anchor_issues: Architecture anchor not created, stale, or not referenced

analysis: Why did this issue occur? (technical root cause)
How frequently does it occur? (every time, edge case, etc.)
What's the fix effort? (minutes, hours, days)

priority_criteria.P0: BLOCKING - Workflow cannot proceed without manual intervention or workaround
priority_criteria.P1: HIGH VALUE - Causes significant friction (5+ minutes wasted) or happens frequently

includes: Root cause analysis of all issues

actions.purpose: Identify systemic issues that appear across multiple test cases
analysis: Which issues appear in multiple test cases? (systemic)
Which issues are test-case specific? (edge cases)
Are there workflow-specific vs tool-specific issues?

workflow_steps.name: Results Aggregation & Benchmarking
workflow_steps.description: Compile all findings, calculate metrics, compare to baseline, generate comprehensive report

actions.description: Calculate aggregate metrics across all test cases

metrics.total_friction_points: Sum of friction points across all test cases
metrics.total_deviations: Sum of deviations required across all test cases
metrics.average_friction_overhead_percent: Average % of time spent on friction vs productive work
metrics.total_test_time_minutes: Total execution time across all test cases
metrics.successful_test_cases: Number of test cases that completed successfully
metrics.failed_test_cases: Number of test cases that could not complete
metrics.hierarchical_tests_passed: Number of hierarchical structure tests (HT-*) that passed
metrics.hierarchical_tests_failed: Number of hierarchical structure tests (HT-*) that failed

actions.description: Generate comprehensive GAN test summary report

actions.condition: If this run is successful and improves on baseline

workflow_steps.name: Decision Gate - Auto-Trigger Fixes
workflow_steps.description: Determine if critical issues require immediate fixes via 98-reflow_feature_update workflow

trigger_98_reflow_feature_update.rationale: P0 issues are BLOCKING, or too many P1 issues with high friction

no_trigger_needed.user_notification: ✅ No critical issues - Reflow quality acceptable

workflow_steps.name: Auto-Trigger 98-reflow_feature_update
workflow_steps.description: Automatically spawn 98-reflow_feature_update workflow to fix critical issues
workflow_steps.conditional: Only if GAN-05 decision is trigger_98

includes: All P0 issues with root causes and recommended fixes
All P1 issues with estimated effort
Reference to GAN test session for context

updates.reflow_feature_description: v3.X.X GAN Test Fixes - Fix P0/P1 issues discovered in GAN test run {timestamp}. Problem: [summary of P0 issues]. Solution: [summary of fixes]. Benefits: [expected friction reduction]

actions.instruction: User should now execute: Implement workflow in /path/to/reflow/workflows/98-reflow_feature_update.json on system /path/to/reflow
actions.note: Workflow 98 will automatically trigger 99-meta_analysis when complete

llm_agent_guidance.auto_triggering: Don't actually execute workflow 98 from within this workflow. Instead, provide clear instructions to the user to execute it. This maintains workflow boundaries and user control.
llm_agent_guidance.context_preservation: Ensure working_memory.json contains reference to GAN test session so workflow 98 can access all context

workflow_steps.name: Cleanup & Reporting
workflow_steps.description: Final cleanup, generate user-facing summary, archive results

actions.format: Concise, actionable summary with key findings and next steps

quality_gates.name: Agent B Execution Complete
checks: All enabled test cases executed by Agent B
Agent B reports generated for each test case

success_criteria.workflow_execution: All test cases executed without workflow crashes
success_criteria.agent_b_reporting: Agent B generates execution reports for all test cases
success_criteria.agent_a_analysis: Agent A generates meta-analysis for all test cases
success_criteria.benchmarking: Metrics calculated and compared to baseline
success_criteria.decision_made: Clear decision on whether to trigger workflow 98

typical_time: 1-4 hours (depends on number and complexity of test cases)

llm_agent_guidance.workflow_purpose: This workflow is Reflow testing itself - a continuous improvement loop. Agent B executes workflows as a user would, Agent A (you) observes and identifies issues.
llm_agent_guidance.agent_separation: CRITICAL: Agent B must be spawned as separate agent via Task tool. Agent B should NOT see expected outputs (blind execution). Agent A analyzes Agent B's execution afterward.
llm_agent_guidance.test_case_execution: For each test case, Agent B should start fresh, follow workflows strictly, and report everything. Don't skip test cases that failed before - failures are valuable data.
llm_agent_guidance.issue_prioritization: Focus on P0 (BLOCKING) and P1 (HIGH VALUE) issues. P2 issues are nice-to-have but don't trigger auto-fixes.
llm_agent_guidance.benchmarking: Always compare to baseline if available. Regression detection is critical - if new version performs worse than baseline, that's a P0 issue.
llm_agent_guidance.auto_trigger_discipline: Only trigger workflow 98 for genuine critical issues. Don't auto-trigger for minor polish items.
